fields.summary: TC-855-01: Assignment Label Logic Correctly Identifies Assignment Type for Phase 1 and Phase 2 Processing

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-855

Precondition: The updated Assignment Label logic has been deployed for Phase 1 and Phase 2. A trip with a known assignment label (e.g., Lineholder or Reserve) is processed. The assignment label must be correctly identified and used to route Phase 1 and Phase 2 processing.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a Lineholder trip assignment and trigger COA Phase 1 processing
Trip with assignmentLabel=Lineholder, crewType=Lineholder
COA Phase 1 processing is triggered with the Lineholder assignment label present in the aggregated event
Verify the Assignment Label Lambda correctly reads and sets the assignment label for the Lineholder trip in the COA record
DynamoDB coatable record after Phase 1 processing for Lineholder trip
DynamoDB record contains assignmentLabel=Lineholder correctly set
Set up a Reserve assignment and trigger COA Phase 1 processing - verify Reserve assignment label is handled correctly
Trip with assignmentLabel=Reserve, crewType=Reserve
COA record for Reserve trip shows assignmentLabel=Reserve correctly
Verify Phase 2 audit processing uses the updated assignment label logic to correctly evaluate audit eligibility
Phase 2 audit triggered for Lineholder trip - assignment label must be evaluated for audit routing
Phase 2 audit uses the correct assignment label and applies the appropriate pay rules for Lineholder vs Reserve
Verify the COA Search App displays the correct assignment label for both Lineholder and Reserve trips after the update
COA Search App queried for a Lineholder and a Reserve trip after Phase 1 processing
COA Search App shows assignmentLabel=Lineholder for lineholder trips and assignmentLabel=Reserve for reserve trips - correct values post-update
